digest.component_or_area: CLI parser and route registry foundation (S2)
propositions: Define a narrow factory protocol and argparse customization that produces deterministic help output and compatibility-shaped parse errors without importing handlers or optional dependencies.

Represent all current command spellings as frozen route records with lazy handler/parser-factory references, validation of duplicates/collisions/contradictions, and derived compatibility policy exports matching the current _cli policy-set.
Registry construction and route lookup must provably not import handlers or optional packages, enforced via subprocess-isolated import validation.
Deprecated/retired commands must be filterable and excluded from shipped policy exports while maintaining validation and composition mechanisms on synthetic routes.
